supersession_reason: A pre-production method audit found that current-centering all geometry makes the static model's current physical coordinates identically zero and that its 96-unit MLP is substantially smaller than the temporal models. V5 preserves raw hole-relative geometry, parameter-matches the static MLP, and replaces the requirement that static accuracy be low with a positive causal advantage over the strongest matched learned baseline. No router data, closed-loop outcome, 425M selection seed, or 429M confirmation seed was opened.
inherited_contract: All V4 task, intervention-physics, outcome, split, safety, cost-reporting, and release fields are inherited unchanged unless explicitly replaced below.

representation_contract.features: four physical relative-position vectors expressed in the randomized hole frame plus normalized prefix time
representation_contract.reason: Hole-relative coordinates already remove global pose; retaining the current frame gives every learned method the same physically meaningful deployment observation.

matched_baselines.heuristic_router: Hole-frame cumulative peg displacement from the initial observation with the same 1 cm evidence threshold as learned-router readiness; blocker routing uses observable inward travel and return.
matched_baselines.comparison_rule: The candidate must exceed the strongest of the static factorized MLP and capacity-matched unstructured GRU; neither baseline is required to perform poorly.

release_rule: An A/A+ method claim requires the existing LearnedRecovery-v4 gate plus both V5 selection and untouched confirmation external-task gates to pass.
